deliverables.assertion: Every catalog and local interaction obligation has one stable batch owner; drift and scope weakening fail self-tests.
Scoped strict acceptance validates the entire catalog and all previously accepted batches; executed failures and missing evidence fail.
The machine-readable checkpoint validates batch order, accepted scope, source identity, migrations and resumable work.
Rust and installed VSIX consume shared marker fixtures with independent exact Unicode, LF/CRLF, multi-file overlay and malformed-fixture assertions.
An installed VSIX driver proves keyboard, pointer, visible widget and final document assertions with bounded waits.
Local results validate source, fixture, driver, VSIX, server, exact profile, action and assertion identities; stale/skipped evidence fails.
Every applicable subcase of S0-S14 and grammar/token/AST contracts is audited; missing partitions are registered and verified.
Register and verify the strategy high-risk combinations with incremental-versus-fresh workspace equivalence.
Fixed seeds cover every valid required pair of local factors, with explicit constraints and finite state sequences.
Reproducible injected failures shrink to useful minimal counterexamples without losing the failure.
Bounded wrong-target, wrong-range and stale-result mutations are detected by independent oracles.
Fixed cold/warm workspace sizes and edit/query workloads meet latency and memory thresholds committed before acceptance measurement, with machine context.
All required whole-repository formatting, Clippy and test gates pass on the candidate source.
A durable local report records all required batches, commands, revisions, profile and artifacts, with B16 explicitly deferred.
